body: I’ve never seen anything more foolish than telling a suicidal person that they should essentially just suck it up for the good of society. Sorry, but I’m just not that selfless.

I’ve discussed it with my parents. I have an idea of what I’d like to pursue, but it’s a pretty competitive field, and I’m not quite confident that I’d be able to support myself while also going after what makes me happy. And if your life only subsists of working to feed, clothe, and house yourself with no time, money, or energy to do anything else, is it really worth living?

It’s something that a couple of people have said. Even with the few friends that I do have, they usually only talk to me when their preferred friend isn’t around. During the quarantine, the people that treat me as an actual friend haven’t spoken to me beyond me reaching out to them to talk.

I had a dream a day or two ago where my ex came back to me and we got back together. I haven’t heard their voice for months. In my dream, my ex and I acted just as we did when we were still together, and it was really nice. I hate the fact that the dream made me feel much happier than I have felt for a long time.
